additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380414-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / P0 170001062]After upgrading lost the CP status CRM:01811000354
additional_info.body:
Hi Szymon,
There is no specific fix available for the indicators mentioned in your email for the outlets. However, there is a hotfix called NSP (Network Security Patch) in firmware version 4.0.11. The problem in DC outlet2 seems to be related to the standby isolation status being invalid in the IMD_BC2, resulting in continuous errors. To address this issue, a site intervention is required to troubleshoot the wires and follow the steps outlined below.
1. Kindly verify the connections of the KF4 module's DI12 & DI13 pins for any loose wiring.
2. Please inspect the 24V DC2 ISO relay.
3. Please ensure all connections related to the Sensing unit and Metering unit are checked.
4. If necessary, please gather the spare parts for both units; if replacement is required, both components will need to be replaced.
